title: Good news - bad news
text: Good news - bad news. First, the size of this set is large. It is wonderful for cooking, straining and storing pasta. It is handy to have as it does all three (no need for a separate strainer) and stores nicely in my pots and pans cabinet. I was disappointed as I did try to store the pasta with sauce in the refrigerator. When I used the remainder I was surprised to see how easily the bowl stained from the red sauce. Several dishwashing loads later, it has faded some but I still can see it. I guess the lesson here is don't store spaghetti sauce in anything plastic (and I already should have known that). Outside of my own stupidity, this is a great set. I just wish the manufacturers would find a way to make these items a little more resistent to staining (for people like me).

description: OXO 3 Piece Large Bowl & Colander Set:

Whether you’re rinsing fresh vegetables for a salad or making pasta for the family, the 3 Piece Large Bowl & Colander Set is the tool for the job. The Bowl and Colander nest for compact storage, so they don’t take up a lot of space in your cabinets. The Bowl features a non-slip bottom for stability while mixing and dual tone colors provide kitchen-to-table appeal. The curved Bowl has no internal angles or corners, ensuring efficient mixing and easy cleaning. The Colander has an elevated ring along the bottom to keep it stable in the sink or on the countertop and elongated holes for fast, efficient draining. The lid seals the Bowl for convenient food storage in the fridge, or rests on nested Bowl and Colander to stack while storing. Bowl, Colander and lid are dishwasher safe.

At OXO, we consistently develop products that address even the tiniest of pet peeves, because we know it’s the little things that make the biggest difference. With our 3 Piece Large Bowl & Colander Set, we felt that since users were straining large amounts of pasta and other foods, it was essential to provide a sturdy grip on the Colander.
Colander fits perfectly in Bowl for no mess straining and the Bowl is curved for efficient mixing and easy cleaning
The lid seals the Bowl for storage and allows for convenient stacking, while the Colander nests neatly inside for compact storage.
An elegant dual-tone Bowl provides kitchen-to-table appeal, perfect for entertaining
A wide, non-slip bottom stabilizes the Bowl while mixing, and comfortable handles on the Colander provide a secure grip while straining large amounts of food
After the initial straining is done, nest the colander inside the bowl to save any extra pasta water. The starch from the water will help sauce adhere to pasta.
